title: ‘Saved!’ toast on a profile save that failed with 409
why: The toast and the reset form both say success, and nothing reaches the console. The edit is simply gone the next time the page loads.
finding: `PATCH /api/profile` returned 409 `{"error":"Profile was modified since it was loaded"}`. `handleSubmit` never checks `res.ok`, and a logpoint on `setVersion` showed the success path running on the 409 response.
actual: Clicking "Save changes" shows a green "Saved!" toast in the bottom-right even though the PATCH request fails with HTTP 409. The edits (bio "Owns the onboarding pipeline and quarterly vendor reviews. Now leads vendor reviews end to end.") are treated as saved — the form's dirty state is reset — but they are not persisted, and the profile header continues to show a stale "Last updated 15m ago" instead of "just now".
expected: When the PATCH /api/profile request returns a non-2xx status (409 Conflict), the app must NOT report success: it should surface the conflict error (e.g. "Profile was modified since it was loaded"), keep the user's typed edits in the form so they can resolve the conflict, and not show a "Saved!" confirmation. Only a successful 2xx response should clear the dirty state and refresh the header's "Last updated" status.

chronology.text: On the Account Center Profile page, the user clicks the 'Save changes' button (button type=submit) in the Personal information section. The frame shows the form with Job title 'Operations Director', the edited Bio, the enabled Save changes button, and the header still reading 'Last updated 15m ago'.

chronology.text: The click sends the save: `PATCH /api/profile` with the edited bio and `"version":2`. The server answers **409 Conflict** 66 ms later, `{"error":"Profile was modified since it was loaded"}`, so nothing was saved. This is the request the replay's DevTools opens on.

A green 'Saved!' toast appears in the bottom-right corner while the profile header still reads 'Last updated 15m ago' (not refreshed to 'just now'). The PATCH /api/profile request actually failed with HTTP 409 and the edits were not persisted.

reproduce.text: Clear the Job title field and type a new job title
Clear the Bio field and type a new bio
Click the Personal information section's Save changes button

rootCause.text: In Profile.jsx, ProfileSection.handleSubmit (lines 51-71) never checks res.ok or the HTTP status: inside the try block it unconditionally does await res.json(), setVersion(updated.version), setInitial(values), queryClient.invalidateQueries(...), and toast('Saved!'). The catch block only fires on network-level failures. So when PATCH /api/profile returns 409 with body {"error":"Profile was modified since it was loaded"}, the code takes the success path: a Logpoint at line 61 (setVersion) shows res.status === 409 and updated === the error body at the moment of execution, and line 65 then shows toast('Saved!'). This yields a false success confirmation and discards the user's edits (setInitial(values) resets the dirty state).

rootCauseSteps.text: Despite the 409, handleSubmit executes the success path: the Logpoint at line 61 fires with resStatus 409 and updated equal to the error body, and line 65 runs toast('Saved!') unconditionally (no res.ok guard exists between them).

Because setInitial(values) resets the form to the typed (unsaved) values, the app shows the stale 'Saved!' confirmation and the profile header keeps its old 'Last updated 15m ago' text — an Evaluate at the save point measured the header still reading 'Last updated 15m ago' with the unsaved bio present in the textarea.
